get.description: Returns providers whose registered category matches the category_id query parameter selected by the frontend from GET /categories.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Existing category identifier selected from GET /categories.

200.description: Providers matching the requested category. The array is empty when the category exists but has no registered providers.

400.description: The category_id query parameter is missing, invalid, zero or negative.

404.description: No category exists with the requested id.

post.summary: Register the authenticated user as a provider
post.description: Creates a provider account for the authenticated Auth0 subject. The Auth0 subject is taken from the Bearer JWT and persisted as the user auth identifier. The current implementation consumes email, name, surname, and category_id; coverage_zone is accepted by JSON binding but is not passed to the provider service or persisted.

get.description: Returns the user associated with the Auth0 subject contained in the Bearer JWT. The response property names currently match the exported Go struct fields because the User struct has no json tags.

401.description: Authentication failed or the authenticated user id could not be obtained from the request context.

missingClaims.summary: JWT claims not available after validation

missingUserId.summary: Subject claim is missing or empty

404.description: No persisted user exists for the authenticated Auth0 subject.

BearerAuth.description: Auth0-issued JWT. The API uses the token subject claim as the internal auth identifier.

RegisterConsumerRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /consumers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from all string fields before validation/persistence.

email.description: Consumer email. Must match the server email validation regex.

name.description: Consumer given name or display name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Consumer surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

RegisterProviderRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /providers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from email, name, and surname before validation/persistence. category_id is required by the domain service. coverage_zone is currently accepted by the request struct but ignored by the service.

email.description: Provider email. Must match the server email validation regex.

name.description: Provider given name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Provider surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

coverage_zone.description: Accepted by JSON binding for backwards compatibility, but the current handler does not pass this value to the provider service and it is not persisted.

category_id.description: Existing category identifier for the provider. Missing or zero values return "Category id is required"; unknown ids return "Category does not exist".

ProviderSummary.description: Provider summary returned by GET /providers when filtering by category_id.

CreateConversationRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /conversations to start a provider work request. The consumer is inferred from the authenticated JWT subject; clients must not send consumer_id or receiver_id.

provider_id.description: Existing provider identifier selected by the consumer.

content.description: Initial message content. Must be non-empty after trimming.
content.example: Hola Juan, necesito reparar una pérdida de agua en la cocina. ¿Podrías ayudarme esta semana?

Conversation.description: Conversation created for a provider work request.

message.description: Present in JWT middleware validation failures.

User.description: Authenticated user response. Field names are currently capitalized because they are serialized from exported Go struct fields without json tags.

AuthID.description: Auth0 subject persisted for this user.

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /categories. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from name before validation and duplicate checks.

name.description: Category display name. Must be non-empty after trimming. Duplicate detection uses a lowercase normalized version.

normalized_name.description: Lowercase category name used by the server for duplicate checks.

CategoryListItem.description: Category list item returned by GET /categories. normalized_name is not included in list responses.
